# Repository Review Governance

- `@owen-introd` is the sole release authority and code owner.
- `@owen-sb` is the backup owner and approved bypass identity.
- `@jack-gitundu` is a Senior Developer with Maintain access. His review may be requested, but it must never be configured as a required approval or release gate.
- Required CI checks remain mandatory wherever configured.
- `@owen-introd` may use the Owen owner bypass for self-authored pull requests only after all required checks pass.
- Changes to this policy require explicit approval from `@owen-introd`.
